name: dz-sandbox-monorepo
description: Local deterministic sandbox simulating Algerian payment and delivery APIs (Chargily Pay v2, SATIM, Yalidine)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @dz-sandbox/core && npm run build -w @dz-sandbox/control -w @dz-sandbox/mock-chargily -w @dz-sandbox/mock-satim -w @dz-sandbox/mock-yalidine -w @dz-sandbox/mock-zrexpress -w @dz-sandbox/mock-maystro -w @dz-sandbox/client && npm run build -w dz-sandbox
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @dz-sandbox/core && npm run typecheck -w @dz-sandbox/control -w @dz-sandbox/mock-chargily -w @dz-sandbox/mock-satim -w @dz-sandbox/mock-yalidine -w @dz-sandbox/mock-zrexpress -w @dz-sandbox/mock-maystro -w @dz-sandbox/client && npm run typecheck -w dz-sandbox
